mods.name: Server API module
mods.summary: Shared game-protocol client for the Optimus.STFC.* mods - centralizes session capture, HTTP headers, and the JSON body shape for STFC's server API, so consumer plugins don't duplicate protocol code.
mods.shortestDescription: shared STFC server's API for other mods
